purpose: Teach: うんざり/ひさし/正反対/太い/手首/片隅/愛着/立ち止まっ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今週の宿題、量、もう、うんざり。
lines.en: I'm so sick of how much homework they're piling on this week.
lines.style: Flat complaint with tired exasperation. Quick, direct attack on the opening. No energy spent performing — just stating fact. Slight drop at the end like the words are too heavy to carry.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ひさしぶりに公園で休もう。
lines.en: We haven't been to the park to just sit in forever.
lines.style: Quiet, gentle suggestion — not pushing, just offering. Soft opening. Speaking more to himself than insisting. The tone of someone who notices when another person needs rest and doesn't make it a thing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 弟と正反対の趣味で、家でいつも対立してる。
lines.en: My brother's into everything I'm not — we're always butting heads about it at home.
lines.style: Wry half-smile underneath. A little exasperated, a little affectionate without meaning to be. Speaking fast through the frustration. The eye-roll of someone who loves someone annoying.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 今日の昼の太いうどん、美味かったな。
lines.en: That thick udon we had at lunch today was actually really good.
lines.style: Small, genuine pleasure in the voice. Warm and simple. Not performing happiness — just noticing something good and sharing it. The tone of someone who savors small things.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: My wrist is killing me from writing so much.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact complaint with underlying discomfort. Quiet and understated — not asking for sympathy, just naming what's true. The exhaustion of pushing through pain.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 公園の片隅のベンチ、座ろう。
lines.en: Let's sit on that bench tucked away in the corner.
lines.style: Invitation layered with gentleness. Speaking softly, like he's opening a small door. No urgency — the warm directness of someone who knows what someone else needs before they ask.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: I'm going to miss this uniform, actually.
lines.style: Surprised by the feeling as she's saying it. Quiet realization. Soft, almost vulnerable. Like she didn't expect to care about this thing until the words came out. Trailing off slightly, letting the feeling settle.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 信号で立ち止まって、空、見上げよう。
lines.en: At the traffic light, let's just stop and look up at the sky.
lines.style: Gentle, thoughtful closing. Slow pace. The careful diction of someone offering something quiet and real. Open ending — not a demand, a small invitation to see something together.
